types.name: JobStorage
docs: Storage metadata for a Silicium job.
The Solana layer stores only hashes and references. The real task inputs,
manifests, outputs, and proof files remain off-chain in the P2P/storage layer.

fields.name: job
docs: Parent job this storage metadata belongs to.

fields.name: manifest_hash
docs: Canonical SHA-256 hash of the complete off-chain job manifest.

fields.name: input_root_hash
docs: Root hash/checksum for all task inputs declared by the manifest.

fields.name: storage_ref_hash
docs: Hash of the storage routing reference or storage manifest.
This should generally be the hash of a small off-chain storage manifest
containing P2P CIDs/URIs and content checksums, not just the hash of a URL.

fields.name: encryption_ref_hash
docs: Optional hash of encryption/key-distribution metadata.
A zero hash means the job does not declare encryption metadata on-chain.

fields.name: declared_by
docs: Wallet that declared the storage metadata.

fields.name: created_at_unix
docs: On-chain timestamp of the declaration.

fields.name: compute_reputation
docs: Score used when this participant acts as a compute worker.

fields.name: verify_reputation
docs: Score used when this participant acts as a verifier.

fields.name: storage_reputation
docs: Score used when this participant stores or serves network data.

fields.name: global_reputation
docs: Derived global score used by dashboards and scheduler heuristics.

fields.name: compute_jobs_done
docs: Category-specific counters for scheduler analytics.
